skin.license_or_terms: NICE states these curated public data have no restrictions on use; retain source attribution
skin.assay_or_guideline: NICE/ICE in-vivo rabbit/human evidence plus OECD TG 439 reconstructed-human-epidermis irritation calls and positive TG 431/430/435 corrosion calls
skin.endpoint_definition: explicit irritant, corrosive, or GHS skin category 1/2 classification
skin.negative_definition: explicit not-classified or non-irritant skin classification
skin.label_mapping: Conservative deterministic mapping in scripts/prepare_ice_bulk_training.py using backend/app/services/nice_evidence.py
skin.review_note: Mixtures, predictions, ambiguous evidence, label conflicts, single-assay in-vitro sensitization calls, and missing structures were excluded

eye.label_mapping: Conservative deterministic mapping in scripts/prepare_ice_bulk_training.py using backend/app/services/nice_evidence.py

sens.license_or_terms: NICE states these curated public data have no restrictions on use; retain source attribution
sens.assay_or_guideline: NICE/ICE human/animal direct sensitization calls plus cross-key-event in-vitro consensus
sens.endpoint_definition: explicit sensitizer/Active classification, reported LLNA EC3 or SI >= 3, or concordant calls across >=2 in-vitro key events
sens.negative_definition: explicit non-sensitizer/Inactive classification or concordant calls across >=2 in-vitro key events; a single SI < 3 is insufficient
sens.label_mapping: Conservative deterministic mapping in scripts/prepare_ice_bulk_training.py using backend/app/services/nice_evidence.py
sens.review_note: Mixtures, predictions, ambiguous evidence, label conflicts, single-assay in-vitro sensitization calls, and missing structures were excluded

acute.license_or_terms: NICE states these curated public data have no restrictions on use; retain source attribution
acute.assay_or_guideline: NICE/ICE in-vivo rat acute oral toxicity records
acute.endpoint_definition: interpretable oral LD50 <= 2000 mg/kg or explicit GHS acute category 1-4
acute.negative_definition: interpretable oral LD50 > 2000 mg/kg or explicit GHS acute category 5
acute.label_mapping: Conservative deterministic mapping in scripts/prepare_ice_bulk_training.py using backend/app/services/nice_evidence.py
